question: A steady current of $1.5 \text{ A}$ flows through a copper wire of cross-sectional area $1.0 \times 10^{-7} \text{ m}^2$. If the number density of conduction electrons in copper is $8.5 \times 10^{28} \text{ m}^{-3}$, calculate the average drift velocity of the electrons. (Charge on electron $e = 1.6 \times 10^{-19} \text{ C}$).
